column2:
pace(n./v.)步調、速度、踱步
(無詞性變化)
keep pace with 跟上…
at one's own pace 按自己的步調
It is hard to keep pace with changing technology.
(要跟上日新月異的科技很困難。)
He paced up and down the room, waiting for the news.
(他在房間裡來回踱步，等待消息。)

panel(n.)小組、專門小組、面板、嵌板
(無詞性變化)
solar panel 太陽能板
a panel of experts 專家小組
There are solar panels on the school roof.
(學校屋頂上有太陽能板。)
A panel of judges chose the winner of the contest.
(一組評審選出了比賽的優勝者。)

parachute(n./v.)降落傘、跳傘
(無詞性變化)
open a parachute 打開降落傘
parachute jump 跳傘
The soldier opened his parachute and landed safely.
(士兵打開降落傘，安全著陸。)
Supplies were parachuted into the flooded village.
(物資被空投到淹水的村莊。)

paragraph(n.)段落
(無詞性變化)
the first paragraph 第一段
topic sentence of a paragraph 段落主題句
Please read the first paragraph aloud.
(請大聲朗讀第一段。)
Each paragraph should have a clear main idea.
(每個段落都應該有清楚的主旨。)

partial(adj.)部分的、偏袒的
partially(adv.)部分地
partial success 部分成功
be partial to 偏愛…
The plan was only a partial success.
(這個計畫只算部分成功。)
My grandmother is partial to sweet desserts.
(我奶奶偏愛甜點。)

participation(n.)參與、參加
participate(v.)參與
participant(n.)參與者
active participation 積極參與
class participation 課堂參與
Class participation counts for 20% of your grade.
(課堂參與佔你成績的百分之二十。)
We thank everyone for their participation in the event.
(我們感謝大家參與這次活動。)

partnership(n.)合夥關係、合作關係
partner(n.)夥伴、搭檔
in partnership with 與…合作
form a partnership 建立合作關係
The school works in partnership with local businesses.
(這所學校與在地企業合作。)
The two companies formed a partnership last year.
(這兩家公司去年建立了合作關係。)

passive(adj.)被動的、消極的
passively(adv.)被動地
passive voice 被動語態
passive attitude 消極的態度
Don't be passive; ask questions in class.
(不要被動，上課要發問。)
We learned how to use the passive voice today.
(我們今天學了被動語態的用法。)

pasta(n.)義大利麵食
(無詞性變化)
cook pasta 煮義大利麵
pasta sauce 義大利麵醬
My mom cooked pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
(我媽媽晚餐煮了番茄醬義大利麵。)
Spaghetti is one of the most popular kinds of pasta.
(直麵是最受歡迎的義大利麵之一。)

paw(n./v.)(動物的)腳掌、用爪子抓或碰
(無詞性變化)
a dog's paw 狗的腳掌
paw at 用爪子撥弄
The puppy hurt its paw while playing.
(小狗玩耍時弄傷了腳掌。)
The cat pawed at the door to get in.
(貓用爪子扒門想進來。)

peculiar(adj.)奇怪的、特有的
peculiarity(n.)特點、怪癖
peculiar to 是…特有的
a peculiar smell 奇怪的味道
There is a peculiar smell coming from the kitchen.
(廚房傳來一股奇怪的味道。)
This kind of bird is peculiar to Taiwan.
(這種鳥是臺灣特有的。)

peep(n./v.)偷看、窺視、瞥一眼
(無詞性變化)
peep through 從…偷看
take a peep at 偷看一眼
The kids peeped through the window at the party.
(孩子們從窗戶偷看派對。)
Let me take a peep at your new phone.
(讓我看一眼你的新手機。)

peer(n./v.)同儕、同輩、凝視
(無詞性變化)
peer pressure 同儕壓力
peer at 凝視、仔細看
Teenagers often feel peer pressure.
(青少年常感受到同儕壓力。)
She peered at the tiny words on the screen.
(她盯著螢幕上的小字仔細看。)

penalty(n.)處罰、罰款、罰球
penalize(v.)處罰
death penalty 死刑
penalty kick 罰球、十二碼球
There is a heavy penalty for drunk driving.
(酒駕會受到重罰。)
He scored the winning goal with a penalty kick.
(他靠十二碼罰球踢進致勝球。)

percent(n.)百分之…
(無詞性變化)
ten percent 百分之十
a 50 percent discount 五折
About 70 percent of the earth is covered by water.
(地球約百分之七十被水覆蓋。)
The store is offering a 20 percent discount.
(這家店正在打八折。)

percentage(n.)百分比、比例
percent(n.)百分之…
a high percentage 高比例
percentage of 某事物的百分比
A high percentage of students passed the exam.
(很高比例的學生通過了考試。)
What percentage of your income do you save?
(你把收入的百分之多少存起來？)

perfection(n.)完美、完善
perfect(adj./v.)完美的、使完美
perfectionist(n.)完美主義者
aim for perfection 追求完美
cooked to perfection 煮得恰到好處
The steak was cooked to perfection.
(這塊牛排煎得恰到好處。)
Nobody can achieve perfection in everything.
(沒有人能在每件事上都做到完美。)

perfume(n./v.)香水、香氣、使充滿香味
(無詞性變化)
wear perfume 擦香水
a bottle of perfume 一瓶香水
She wore a light perfume to the party.
(她擦了淡淡的香水去參加派對。)
Flowers perfumed the air in the garden.
(花朵讓花園的空氣充滿香氣。)

permanent(adj.)永久的、持久的
permanently(adv.)永久地
permanent job 固定工作
permanent damage 永久損傷
Loud music can cause permanent damage to your ears.
(大聲的音樂可能對耳朵造成永久傷害。)
She is looking for a permanent job.
(她正在找一份固定的工作。)

persuasion(n.)說服、勸說
persuade(v.)說服
persuasive(adj.)有說服力的
power of persuasion 說服力
after much persuasion 經過一番勸說
After much persuasion, he agreed to join us.
(經過一番勸說，他同意加入我們。)
Good leaders have strong powers of persuasion.
(好的領導者有很強的說服力。)

persuasive(adj.)有說服力的
persuade(v.)說服
persuasion(n.)說服
persuasive essay 論說文
persuasive argument 有說服力的論點
We have to write a persuasive essay this week.
(我們這週要寫一篇論說文。)
Her speech was very persuasive.
(她的演講非常有說服力。)

pessimistic(adj.)悲觀的
pessimist(n.)悲觀主義者
pessimism(n.)悲觀主義
be pessimistic about 對…悲觀
a pessimistic view 悲觀的看法
He is pessimistic about his chances of winning.
(他對自己獲勝的機會感到悲觀。)
Don't be so pessimistic; things will get better.
(別那麼悲觀，事情會好轉的。)

pest(n.)害蟲、討厭的人
pesticide(n.)殺蟲劑、農藥
pest control 病蟲害防治
garden pests 園藝害蟲
Farmers use different methods to control pests.
(農夫用不同方法來防治害蟲。)
My little brother can be a real pest sometimes.
(我弟弟有時候真的很煩人。)

phenomenon(n.)現象
phenomena(n.)現象(複數)
phenomenal(adj.)非凡的
natural phenomenon 自然現象
social phenomenon 社會現象
A rainbow is a beautiful natural phenomenon.
(彩虹是一種美麗的自然現象。)
Online shopping has become a global phenomenon.
(網路購物已成為全球現象。)

philosopher(n.)哲學家
philosophy(n.)哲學
Greek philosopher 希臘哲學家
a great philosopher 偉大的哲學家
Socrates was a famous Greek philosopher.
(蘇格拉底是著名的希臘哲學家。)
Confucius was a great Chinese philosopher.
(孔子是偉大的中國哲學家。)

philosophical(adj.)哲學的、達觀的
philosophy(n.)哲學
philosophically(adv.)達觀地
philosophical question 哲學問題
be philosophical about 對…看得開
What is happiness? That is a philosophical question.
(什麼是幸福？那是個哲學問題。)
He was philosophical about losing the game.
(他對輸掉比賽看得很開。)

philosophy(n.)哲學、人生觀
philosopher(n.)哲學家
philosophical(adj.)哲學的
philosophy of life 人生觀
study philosophy 研讀哲學
My philosophy of life is to enjoy every day.
(我的人生觀是享受每一天。)
She decided to study philosophy at university.
(她決定在大學念哲學。)

photography(n.)攝影、攝影術
photographer(n.)攝影師
photograph(n.)照片
nature photography 自然攝影
photography club 攝影社
He joined the photography club in high school.
(他高中時加入了攝影社。)
Photography is not allowed in this museum.
(這間博物館禁止攝影。)

physical(adj.)身體的、物質的、物理的
physically(adv.)身體上
physical education 體育課
physical activity 身體活動
Physical activity is good for your health.
(身體活動對健康有益。)
We have physical education class twice a week.
(我們每週上兩次體育課。)

physician(n.)醫師、內科醫生
(無詞性變化)
family physician 家庭醫師
consult a physician 諮詢醫師
You should consult a physician if the pain continues.
(如果疼痛持續，你應該去看醫生。)
Our family physician knows our health history well.
(我們的家庭醫師很清楚我們的健康史。)

physicist(n.)物理學家
physics(n.)物理學
a famous physicist 著名的物理學家
nuclear physicist 核子物理學家
Albert Einstein was a famous physicist.
(愛因斯坦是著名的物理學家。)
She dreams of becoming a physicist.
(她夢想成為一位物理學家。)

physics(n.)物理學
physical(adj.)物理的
physicist(n.)物理學家
physics class 物理課
laws of physics 物理定律
Physics is my favorite subject.
(物理是我最喜歡的科目。)
Nothing can break the laws of physics.
(沒有任何東西能違反物理定律。)

pickle(n.)醃黃瓜、醃菜
pickled(adj.)醃漬的
a jar of pickles 一罐醃黃瓜
in a pickle 處於困境
I don't like pickles in my hamburger.
(我不喜歡漢堡裡有醃黃瓜。)
I forgot my wallet and was in a real pickle.
(我忘了帶錢包，陷入了困境。)

pioneer(n./v.)先驅、拓荒者、開創
pioneering(adj.)開創性的
a pioneer in 某領域的先驅
pioneer a method 首創一種方法
She was a pioneer in women's education.
(她是女性教育的先驅。)
The company pioneered the use of solar energy.
(這家公司率先使用太陽能。)

plentiful(adj.)大量的、豐富的
plenty(n.)大量、充足
plentiful supply 充足的供應
plentiful food 豐富的食物
Fruit is plentiful in Taiwan during the summer.
(臺灣夏天水果很豐富。)
Fresh water is not plentiful in desert areas.
(沙漠地區的淡水並不充足。)

plot(n./v.)情節、陰謀、密謀、小塊地
(無詞性變化)
the plot of a movie 電影情節
plot against 密謀對付
The plot of the movie was hard to follow.
(這部電影的情節很難理解。)
They plotted to steal the jewels.
(他們密謀偷竊珠寶。)

plum(n.)李子、梅子
(無詞性變化)
plum tree 李樹、梅樹
plum blossom 梅花
The plum blossom is the national flower of Taiwan.
(梅花是中華民國的國花。)
She made jam from fresh plums.
(她用新鮮李子做果醬。)

plumber(n.)水管工人
plumbing(n.)水管設備、管線工程
call a plumber 叫水電工
a skilled plumber 技術好的水管工
We called a plumber to fix the leaking pipe.
(我們打電話叫水電工來修漏水的水管。)
The plumber came quickly and fixed the sink.
(水電工很快就來修好了水槽。)

poisonous(adj.)有毒的
poison(n./v.)毒藥、下毒
poisonous snake 毒蛇
poisonous gas 毒氣
Some mushrooms are poisonous, so don't eat them.
(有些蘑菇有毒，所以不要吃。)
Be careful of poisonous snakes in the mountains.
(在山上要小心毒蛇。)

polish(n./v.)擦亮、磨光、亮光劑、潤飾
polished(adj.)擦亮的、精練的
nail polish 指甲油
polish one's English 磨練英文
He polished his shoes before the interview.
(他面試前把鞋子擦亮。)
You should polish your essay before handing it in.
(交作文前你應該再潤飾一下。)

popularity(n.)受歡迎、普及
popular(adj.)受歡迎的
gain popularity 越來越受歡迎
popularity among 在…之間受歡迎
The game gained popularity among teenagers.
(這款遊戲在青少年間越來越受歡迎。)
The singer's popularity grew after the show.
(那位歌手在節目播出後人氣上升。)

portable(adj.)便於攜帶的、手提式的
(無詞性變化)
portable charger 行動電源
portable speaker 攜帶式喇叭
Don't forget to bring your portable charger.
(別忘了帶你的行動電源。)
This portable speaker is light and easy to carry.
(這個攜帶式喇叭又輕又方便帶。)

portray(v.)描繪、描寫、扮演
portrayal(n.)描繪、扮演
portrait(n.)肖像、畫像
portray sb. as 把某人描繪成…
portray a character 飾演一個角色
The movie portrays him as a hero.
(這部電影把他描繪成英雄。)
The actor portrayed a teacher in the drama.
(那位演員在劇中飾演一位老師。)

possess(v.)擁有、具有
possession(n.)擁有、財產
possessive(adj.)占有慾強的
possess talent 具有天分
possess a license 持有執照
She possesses a great talent for music.
(她擁有極高的音樂天分。)
You must possess a license to drive a car.
(你必須有駕照才能開車。)

possession(n.)擁有、財產、所有物
possess(v.)擁有
personal possessions 個人財物
in possession of 擁有…
The fire destroyed all their possessions.
(那場火燒毀了他們所有的財物。)
He was found in possession of stolen goods.
(他被發現持有贓物。)

postage(n.)郵資、郵費
post(n./v.)郵件、郵寄
postage stamp 郵票
postage paid 郵資已付
How much is the postage for this letter?
(這封信的郵資是多少？)
The postage to Japan is more expensive.
(寄到日本的郵資比較貴。)

potential(adj./n.)潛在的、可能的、潛力
potentially(adv.)潛在地
reach one's potential 發揮潛力
potential danger 潛在危險
Every student has the potential to succeed.
(每個學生都有成功的潛力。)
We must be aware of the potential dangers of the internet.
(我們必須注意網路的潛在危險。)

precise(adj.)精確的、準確的
precisely(adv.)精確地、正是
precision(n.)精確
precise instructions 明確的指示
to be precise 精確地說
The teacher gave us precise instructions.
(老師給了我們明確的指示。)
The train arrived at precisely nine o'clock.
(火車正好在九點整抵達。)

predict(v.)預測、預言
prediction(n.)預測
predictable(adj.)可預測的
predict the future 預測未來
hard to predict 難以預測
No one can predict the future.
(沒有人能預測未來。)
Experts predict that more people will work from home.
(專家預測會有更多人在家工作。)

prediction(n.)預測、預言
predict(v.)預測
make a prediction 做出預測
weather prediction 天氣預測
His prediction about the game turned out to be right.
(他對比賽的預測結果是對的。)
It is difficult to make predictions about the economy.
(要預測經濟情勢很困難。)

pregnancy(n.)懷孕、懷孕期
pregnant(adj.)懷孕的
during pregnancy 懷孕期間
pregnancy test 驗孕
Women should not smoke during pregnancy.
(女性在懷孕期間不應抽菸。)
She felt tired in the early months of her pregnancy.
(她在懷孕初期感到很疲倦。)

pregnant(adj.)懷孕的
pregnancy(n.)懷孕
get pregnant 懷孕
pregnant women 孕婦
My aunt is pregnant with her second child.
(我阿姨正懷著第二胎。)
Please give your seat to pregnant women.
(請讓座給孕婦。)

presentation(n.)報告、簡報、呈現、贈送
present(v.)呈現、贈送
give a presentation 做報告
presentation skills 簡報技巧
I have to give a presentation in English class tomorrow.
(我明天英文課要上台報告。)
Good presentation skills are useful in any job.
(良好的簡報技巧在任何工作中都很有用。)

preservation(n.)保存、保護
preserve(v.)保存、保護
historic preservation 古蹟保存
food preservation 食物保存
The preservation of old buildings is important.
(保存老建築很重要。)
Salt has long been used for food preservation.
(鹽很早就被用來保存食物。)

preserve(v.)保存、保護、維持
preservation(n.)保存
preservative(n.)防腐劑
preserve the environment 保護環境
preserve traditions 保存傳統
We must work together to preserve the environment.
(我們必須一起努力保護環境。)
The village has preserved its traditional culture.
(這個村莊保存了其傳統文化。)

prevention(n.)預防、防止
prevent(v.)預防、阻止
preventive(adj.)預防的
disease prevention 疾病預防
crime prevention 犯罪防治
Prevention is better than cure.
(預防勝於治療。)
The government spends a lot on disease prevention.
(政府在疾病預防上花了很多錢。)

prime(adj./n.)主要的、最好的、全盛時期
(無詞性變化)
prime minister 首相、總理
in one's prime 正值壯年、全盛時期
The prime minister will visit Taiwan next month.
(那位首相下個月將訪問臺灣。)
The athlete was in his prime at the age of 25.
(這名運動員在25歲時正處於巔峰期。)

primitive(adj.)原始的、簡陋的
(無詞性變化)
primitive society 原始社會
primitive tools 原始工具
Primitive people used stone tools to hunt.
(原始人使用石器打獵。)
The cabin was primitive, with no electricity.
(那間小屋很簡陋，沒有電。)

priority(n.)優先、優先事項
prior(adj.)在先的
prioritize(v.)優先處理
top priority 首要之務
give priority to 優先考慮
Your health should be your top priority.
(你的健康應該是首要之務。)
Buses give priority to elderly passengers.
(公車優先禮讓年長乘客。)

privacy(n.)隱私、私生活
private(adj.)私人的
invade one's privacy 侵犯隱私
privacy policy 隱私權政策
Reading my diary is an invasion of my privacy.
(看我的日記是侵犯我的隱私。)
Teenagers need some privacy.
(青少年需要一些隱私。)

privilege(n./v.)特權、榮幸、給予特權
privileged(adj.)享有特權的
a great privilege 莫大的榮幸
special privileges 特權
It is a privilege to meet you.
(能見到您是我的榮幸。)
Senior students have some special privileges.
(高年級學生享有一些特權。)

procedure(n.)程序、步驟、手續
procedural(adj.)程序上的
standard procedure 標準程序
follow the procedure 遵照程序
Please follow the safety procedures in the lab.
(在實驗室裡請遵守安全程序。)
Applying for a passport is a simple procedure.
(申請護照的手續很簡單。)

proceed(v.)繼續進行、前往
procedure(n.)程序
process(n.)過程
proceed with 繼續進行…
proceed to 前往…
Let's proceed with the meeting.
(我們繼續開會吧。)
Passengers should proceed to Gate 5.
(旅客請前往五號登機門。)

productive(adj.)多產的、有成效的
productivity(n.)生產力
product(n.)產品
a productive day 充實的一天
productive land 肥沃的土地
I had a very productive day at the library.
(我在圖書館度過了非常有效率的一天。)
Getting enough sleep makes you more productive.
